Dialogs.Dialog: You know how people always talk about their "type"？ I figured I'd ask about yours.
Smart I get, but what do you mean, strong-willed？
Like, she says what she wants, even if it's a bit harsh.
Oh, sounds good！ The fiercer the better.
A kind, proactive girl, I'd say.
Huh？ Did I say anything weird？
But you seem kind of sulky...
Rinko？ Why？ It's just the usual cold, passive Rinko.
Someone like you are right now, ▲小早川＊▲...
You're cool and smart, ▲小早川＊▲. I like that sort of thing.
Eh？ Did I say something weird？
The worst part is that you don't even realize it...
So what's your type again？ I'll ask, just for a laugh.
I see... So you want someone who complements you.
In other words, you want what you don't have.
I see！ Because I'm so intense and annoying！
Well, someone like you are right now, ▲小早川＊▲...
W-What did you just say!? Are you an idiot!?
It's easier for me to relax when you're a little rough like that.
Huh!? What's that supposed to mean？
For Rinko... it's not about types. It's, you know... that thing.
It's working out through some complicated mental process you could never understand, okay！
I thought I'd ask what your latest "type" of girl is.
A cool and calm type, I think.
But, but Rinko was sure you'd say...
Never mind. Oh, I see... This is hard...
Someone like you are right now, ▲小早川＊▲, maybe？
Geez... Rinko wants you to tell her the truth, you know.
I am telling the truth. You've gotten more honest lately.
Oh, I see... Yeah. Then that's fine.
(I really like the way ▲小早川＊▲ is right now.)
Okay, time to give library duty my all again today...
▲小早川＊▲ is not here... Is she skipping？
What, I'm not allowed to be here？
You're not. You're skipping committee duty.
Come on, just a little. I'm not skipping, I'm recharging my batteries.
For what... I'm heading back, so you'd better come too.
No. I just wanted someone next to me. Is that not enough？
If something happens again, tell me, okay？
Okay, time to give library duty my all today！
You don't look too lively, ▲小早川＊▲.
I feel sluggish and my head hurts.
You don't have to be so shocked.
But you're not feeling well. I'll do your work for you, so why not go home？
Don't exaggerate the situation. You worry too much.
Geez, he took it seriously. I can't even fake being sick in peace.
Nothing. You're such a worrywart big brother！
(I'm not on library committee duty today. I'll just relax.)
Bored as usual, huh？ Look at that slack face.
Not true. I'm actually busy with all sorts of stuff.
We've been talking for a while.
Well, actually, Rinko was also bored.
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲, aren't you on library duty today？
Oh, right... Eh, I'll just skip it.
But ▲小早川＊▲, you've been skipping a lot lately.
Pretty soon the penalty kicks in: a one-month ban on borrowing books.
Ow！ It's not my fault, is it!?
It is！ You're on Rinko's side, so you have to look after her！
Rinko says so, so it's fine！
I got it, I got it. But you should hurry to work. I'll be sure to warn you early next time.
They're here. Hide Rinko for a sec.
(That's a first-year homeroom teacher... So she was running from a teacher.)
Hey, don't squish up against me so much！
Whatever, who cares. You liked it, admit it.
What's up？ Why are you so flustered？
Well, it's weird, right？ Rinko being in a place like this.
At a flower shop？ It doesn't fit your image, I guess.
Even Rinko puts flowers in her room sometimes.
Hey. Is Rinko with flowers weird after all？ Does it make you laugh？
▲小早川＊▲ is a girl, after all.
That's kind of a loaded way to put it... but okay, then. Hehe.
But I'm kind of curious what ▲小早川＊▲'s room looks like.
If you're curious, you could just come over...
(It's so quiet and peaceful at school today.)
It was from the back of that building. I'd better check...
(I feel like I've seen something that I'm not supposed to see.)
Every second. You really love cats, huh.
So what？ They're cute, I can't help it.
So are you, ▲小早川＊▲！ I thought you were a cat.
Whoa... What was that just now with ▲小早川＊▲...
Ugh, thirty laps around the field...
Well, yeah, when they make you run this much...
Just a little more today. Hang in there.
Sports, huh... Can't believe you bother.
Pretty much. ...That girl just now is really cool.
▲高嶺＊＊▲, huh？ So girls see her that way too.
"Also"？ So you think she's good-looking too？
(I'm done with this shelf. What's next...？)
There's a book I'm looking for.
Don't mention it. I'm on the library committee. It's no trouble.
Well, guess I'll head home soon...
I'm going home. Put the returned books back.
Sorry for stopping you. I'll get going.
Since when are you so popular？
You saw that？ It's not like that.
Hmm？ But you two look good together.
As if！ Are you stupid？ You don't match at all！
Hehe. I'm here to observe. I'll try not to bother you, so can I stay and watch？
Sure, but I'm about to meet with my doubles partner.
Hmm. Guess Rinko's in the way, then. I'm going home.
What's with that girl？ She took off in a hurry.
Just passing by. Oh right, you work here, don't you.
Yeah, there's a lot of fun stuff, actually.
▲主人公＊▲. Could you come here a sec？
Listen. A customer I just rang up was praising you.
Yeah. They said you were polite, always smiling, and pleasant to deal with.
I'll take you to your seat.
I don't like this waiter's attitude.
Your face is all grinning. It's creepy.
Someone seems to have left this. A pencil case was on the floor under the desk by the window.
Oh, thanks. That's very kind of you.
Hehe. You do your committee work properly too, even with your part-time job keeping you busy.
▲小早川＊▲, good timing. Someone just left this behind...
What am I supposed to do with these again？
Rinko's not your big sister, so quit asking her every little thing.
Why are you mad？ That's not cool.
"Oh, thanks. That's very kind of you."
(Why was she so mad like that？)
I should get going. If we're too friendly, people might think we're a couple.
Just kidding. Look at you blushing.
She sometimes says stuff that makes my heart skip.
▲小早川＊▲？ Eh？ How long have you been here？
If you're with Rinko, people probably just see a brother and sister.
Thanks to you, school maybe wasn't so bad after all.
Glad to hear it. Keep it together even without me around.
There you go acting older again. You were like a hopeless big brother.
(She really was like a little sister...)
Yeah, thanks. Lonely now that I'm graduating？
Thanks to you, Rinko could change. Thank you.
And honestly, I wanted you to stay by my side much, much longer.
But it didn't work. Rinko was always just a little sister. You never saw her as a woman.
